jobs.name: validate

steps.name: Verify the owner's existing funding declaration and disabled production
Exercise controller, risk, measurement and financial boundaries
Verify real Docker backup, private preview and image rollback without production
Verify recovery even if the new application process has exited
Test public trend sources without authentication or paid APIs
Validate exact source in isolated containers, including four browser configurations
Package the disabled, reviewed host controller
